# A cannon bolt: a stretched octahedron 0.15 x 0.5 m along +Z (the game turns +Z along its flight),
# bright cyan core, aqua rim; unlit.
new
material new Core --base-color 0.424 0.929 0.929 --emission 0.424 0.929 0.929 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.424 0.725 0.788 --emission 0.424 0.725 0.788 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Bolt --radius 0.5 --subdivisions 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.2 0.55
apply --scale
material assign Rim
add mesh ico-sphere --name Core --radius 0.5 --subdivisions 1 --location 0 -0.04 0.05
scale 0.12 0.12 0.36
apply --scale
material assign Core
select all
shade flat
export bolt.glb
